m1.typescript: m1 a change that regresses nothing and stays inside its limits gets a go with no reasons

e1.typescript: e1 a must pass case that fails blocks the change and the ids are listed in order

e2.typescript: e2 a protected segment that lost answers blocks the change even when gains elsewhere match the losses

e3.typescript: e3 more losses than gains blocks the change and both counts are named

e4.typescript: e4 a cost rise over the limit blocks the change and a rise exactly at the limit does not

e5.typescript: e5 the tail is the nearest rank 95th percentile and a single slow case does not block

e6.typescript: e6 a roll out advances when healthy holds with too few requests and rolls back to zero when errors pass the limit

e7.typescript: e7 the retirement calendar counts days ranks the nearest first and names the level

e8.typescript: e8 migration removes the settings the new model refuses and names each change

wrong-must-pass-ignored.defect: lets a change through although a case that must pass now fails

wrong-protected-ignored.defect: ignores a loss in a protected segment when the totals are equal

wrong-net-loss-ignored.defect: does not block a change that loses more answers than it gains

wrong-cost-at-limit.defect: blocks a cost rise that equals the limit

wrong-cost-rounded.defect: rounds the cost rise up to the next whole percent instead of down

wrong-p95-max.defect: judges the tail by the slowest single case

wrong-rollout-min-ignored.defect: moves a stage on before it has seen enough requests

wrong-rollout-no-rollback.defect: keeps advancing a roll-out whose errors passed the limit

wrong-days-by-name.defect: lists the models by name and not by how soon they retire

wrong-level-boundary.defect: calls a model with exactly fourteen days left merely something to migrate

wrong-migrate-keeps-sampling.defect: leaves the sampling settings in the migrated request

wrong-migrate-keeps-forced-tool.defect: leaves a forced tool choice in the migrated request
